title: The Python SDK for ZDX: where its ZDX behavior is covered

prose.text: The Python SDK reaches ZDX through `client.zdx` on a OneAPI client or through the legacy ZDX client; its ZDX modules, methods and endpoints are generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface zdx`. This subject points to the behavior around them.

prose.label: Versions.
prose.text: The 2.x beta line covers ZDX and drops the legacy clients: [[cloud-connector.api.client-coverage:python-v2-excludes-ztw]] and [[zpa.sdk-python.client-configuration:python-v2-no-legacy]].

prose.label: Requests.
prose.text: How arguments become query parameters, and the filters that go out under other names, are in [[zdx.sdk-python.request-shaping]].

prose.label: Results.
prose.text: Envelopes, attributes that come back None, and paging are in [[zdx.sdk-python.response-models]].

prose.label: Legacy client.
prose.text: The direct-host client, its token cache and its behavior after the token expires are in [[zdx.sdk-python.legacy-client]].

prose.label: Per area.
prose.text: Deep traces: [[zdx.diagnostics.start-request]] and [[zdx.diagnostics.session-records]]. Score analysis: [[zdx.diagnostics.analysis]]. Snapshots: [[zdx.alerts.snapshot]]. Coverage against Go and the contract: [[zdx.api.client-coverage]].
